name: HotStuff
summary: HotStuff is a leader-based BFT protocol with linear communication complexity. A rotating leader collects votes into Quorum Certificates (QCs), and commit requires a three-chain of linked QCs. Pipelining (Chained HotStuff) lets consecutive views overlap so the protocol runs at network speed under stable leaders.

scenarios.title: Chained HotStuff: pipelined phases
scenarios.description: Each view, the leader proposes a block and collects n-f votes into a Quorum Certificate. The chain of QCs (Prepare, PreCommit, Commit) is pipelined: the same message can serve as the Prepare vote for one block and the PreCommit vote for its predecessor. Communication complexity per block is linear in the number of replicas.

scenarios.title: View change: rotating leader after suspected failure
scenarios.description: When a leader is suspected faulty (a timeout fires), every replica sends its highest-QC to the next-view leader. The new leader picks the highest QC as its starting point and proposes the next block.
